title: 第十九章 羞辱第二十章 残暴上
lines: 镍龙们动了。
作为群居的恶龙，镍龙们早在长久相处中变得默契非常，根本不用交流号令，随着第一条镍龙暴起，其他几条也紧随其后扑出，前后相差不过半秒。
镍龙是小型龙种，比中大型的铬龙要小很多，雏龙期大约只有一米半左右，却个个灵活，犹如狼群。
它们沿着凹凸不平的砂石地窜动，灰白的影子交错穿插，从四面八方一齐绞杀而至。
獠牙、利爪，还有倒钩如毒蝎的龙尾。
领头的比多冲在最前，脑袋上的黑斑涨得发紫，凶相毕露，他扑的又快又狠，獠牙直取西隆的咽喉。
西隆在合围的阴影中，陡然一转。
没什么山呼海啸的动静，比多只觉得面前铬龙鬼魅般一晃，视线里的龙之轮廓便即刻消失。
他的扑击完全落在空处，原本直取咽喉的獠牙，也彻底丢失目标。
紧接着，一道冷厉的爪锋，贴着他的面颊，忽然笔直的斩切下来。
比多立刻瞪大眼睛，他刚刚落地，却想也不想，脑袋一缩，直接就往砂石地翻滚出去，这才堪堪闪过。
饶是如此，锋利的爪尖依旧划到比多的脸，割出了一道又深又长的伤口。
血液顿时喷涌出来，糊住了他整个面孔。
好快。
比多的心脏顿时一紧，这是他第一次面对山谷里的强大者，如此迅猛的抓势，如此锋利的手爪，这一击要是命中，岂不是要把他的喉咙也切开了？
这样想着，比多立刻色变，莫名的一阵惊恐，这种感觉和平时的雏龙打斗完全不同，这家伙……难道是冲着杀死他们来的？
“铬龙是最邪恶的重质龙，性喜杀戮，热衷破坏。”
一条龙之传承里的描述冒了出来。
比多晃了晃脑袋，强行压制心里的惊慌，铬龙又怎么样，龙种差距再大，现在大家也都只是雏龙，以少敌多，算不得什么威胁。
五条镍龙构成的包围圈，别说铬龙，哪怕铁龙来了，他们也敢去啃上一啃。
然而，比多还未从思索中回过神来，就陡然听到一声凄厉的痛吼。
一条镍龙窜得太急，还未等到同伴掩护就位，在无人吸引铬龙注意的情况下，仍然想要强行发动进攻。
结果立即付出代价。
西隆的利爪太快太准，比多甚至没看清它是怎么落下来的，只听见“嗤”的一声的裂响，好像狞亮的刀刃一闪而过，毫无阻碍的切开皮革。
凑近的镍龙躲闪不及，白灰色的手爪刚刚伸出，就被一道更森冷的爪锋齐根削下。
它锋利的右爪就此截断，所有的爪趾都在一瞬间被切了下来，切开的伤口平滑如镜，露出里面森白的骨茬，血液喷涌如柱。
直到扑倒在地，镍龙才发出一声歇斯底里的悲鸣。
雏龙哪里经受过这样的疼痛，它的力量在一瞬间溃散殆尽，居然再也爬不起来。
“盯紧……他的爪子！”
比多声音狰狞，几乎咬牙切齿。
content_en:
The nickel dragons moved.
As evil dragons that live in groups, the nickel dragons have developed a tacit understanding after getting along for a long time. They do not need to exchange orders at all. As the first nickel dragon burst into flames, several others followed closely and pounced, within half a second of each other.
Nickel dragons are small dragon species, much smaller than medium and large chromium dragons. They are only about one and a half meters in hatchling stage, but they are all as agile as a pack of wolves.
They were running along the uneven gravel ground, gray-white shadows criss-crossing, strangled from all directions.
Fangs, sharp claws, and a dragon tail with barbs like poisonous scorpions.
Biduo, the leader, rushed forward. The black spots on his head turned purple, showing his fierce look. He pounced fast and hard, and his fangs went straight to Shillong's throat.
Shillong suddenly turned around in the shadow of the encirclement.
There was no movement like a roaring mountain or a tsunami. Biduo only felt the chromium dragon in front of him flicker like a ghost, and the outline of the dragon in his sight immediately disappeared.
His pounce fell completely in the air, and the fangs that were originally aimed at the throat completely missed their target.
Immediately afterwards, a cold and sharp claw touched his cheek and suddenly cut it straight down.
Bido's eyes widened immediately. He had just landed, but without thinking, his head shrunk and he rolled directly onto the gravel ground, only to be able to dodge.
Even so, the sharp claw tip still scratched Bi Duo's face, cutting a deep and long wound.
Blood suddenly spurted out, covering his entire face.
So fast.
Biduo's heart suddenly tightened. This was the first time he faced a powerful person in the valley. With such a swift grasp and such sharp claws, if this blow hit, wouldn't it mean that his throat would also be cut open?
Thinking of this, Biduo's expression immediately changed, and he felt an inexplicable panic. This feeling was completely different from the usual baby dragon fights. Is this guy... coming to kill them?
"Chrome dragons are the most evil heavy dragons. They like killing and destroying."
The description in "Legacy of a Dragon" appeared.
Biduo shook his head and suppressed the panic in his heart. So what about the chrome dragon? No matter how big the gap between dragon species is, everyone is just a young dragon now. With a small number against a large number, it is not much of a threat.
Surrounded by five nickel dragons, not to mention the chrome dragon, even if the iron dragon comes, they dare to take a bite.
"Roar——"
However, before Biduo could recover from his thoughts, he suddenly heard a shrill roar of pain.
A nickel dragon ran too fast and didn't wait for its companions to take cover. It still wanted to launch an attack forcefully without anyone attracting the chrome dragon's attention.
The consequences pay off immediately.
Shillong's sharp claw was so fast and accurate that Bido didn't even see how it fell. He only heard a cracking sound of "chi", as if a ferocious blade flashed past, cutting through the leather without any hindrance.
The approaching Nickel Dragon was unable to dodge, and as soon as its white-gray claws stretched out, they were cut off by a colder claw blade.
Its sharp right claw was cut off, and all the toes were cut off in an instant. The wound was as smooth as a mirror, revealing the white bone stubble inside, and blood gushed out like a column.
It wasn't until he fell to the ground that Nickel Dragon let out a hysterical cry.
The young dragon had never experienced such pain. Its strength was completely exhausted in an instant, and it could no longer get up.
"Watch...his claws!"
Biduo's voice was ferocious, almost gritting his teeth.
